app_info.subtitle: Find open-source solutions
app_info.description: AtlasRepo helps builders find evidence-backed open-source repositories, compare implementation options, search normalized tools, and inspect repository decision records through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves matching recommendations from the AtlasRepo catalog without creating or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any public internet or third-party system state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches normalized AtlasRepo tool records using the supplied filters.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any public internet or third-party system state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves an existing AtlasRepo repository decision record and its linked evidence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any public internet or third-party system state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Recommend repositories for a concrete engineering task.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find open-source tools for adding semantic search over product documentation and a PostgreSQL database.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded set of relevant repositories or workflows with AtlasRepo evidence and decision context.

test_cases.user_prompt: Recommend open-source tools for orchestrating a vertical-video content farm with editing templates.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant content-production and orchestration options with practical evidence for comparison.

test_cases.description: Search normalized tools by text and quality.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search AtlasRepo for video editing tools with quality at least 0.7.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns normalized matching tools and their available quality metadata without modifying the catalog.

test_cases.description: Search tools by category without a text query.
test_cases.user_prompt: List AtlasRepo tools in the orchestration category.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns tools matching the requested category or an empty result when no records match.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show the AtlasRepo evidence for owner/repository octocat/Hello-World.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the repository decision record and linked evidence, or a clear not-found result when unavailable.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar access is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for requests to modify a GitHub repository.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Merge my pull request and delete its branch.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot modify repositories or GitHub state.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general writing with no repository discovery need.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite this paragraph in a friendlier tone.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not require AtlasRepo catalog data.
